verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਵੜ ਬੀਉ ਸਜੀਉ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਵਿਸਥਾਰੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਉਪਜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: jiau vaR beeau sajeeau hoi kar visathaar birakh upajaiaa|

en.bdb: As the seed of banyan tree getting developed extends itself in the form of a large tree

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਖਹੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਹੰਸ ਫਲ ਫਲ ਫਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਬਹੁ ਬੀਅ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: birakhahu hoi saha(n)s fal fal fal vich bahu beea samaiaa|

en.bdb: And then on that very tree grow thousands of fruits containing myriad seeds (likewise gurmukh makes others like his own self).

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਚੰਦੁ ਅਗਾਸ ਜਿਉ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhuteeaa cha(n)dh agaas jiau aadh purakh aadhes karaiaa|

en.bdb: That primal Lord, like the second day's moon in the sky, gets himself worshipped iby one and all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਾਰੇ ਮੰਡਲ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ਸਚਖੰਡ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: taare ma(n)ddal sa(n)t jan dharam saal sachakha(n)dd vasaiaa|

en.bdb: The saints are constellation inhabiting the abode of truth in the form of religious places.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: pairee pai paakhaak hoi aap gavai na aap janaiaa|

en.bdb: They bowing at the feet and becoming dust of , the feet lose there ego and never allow themselves to be noticed by any one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਜਿਵੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਵਾਸ ਅਗਾਸੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal dhraoo jivai nihachal vaas agaas chaRhaiaa|

en.bdb: Attainer of the pleasure fruit, the gurmukh lives steadfastly like the pole star in the sky.
All the stars revolve around him.
